title: Reproducibility Package: Technical Efficiency and Enteric Methane Emission Intensity in a Transition-Economy Dairy Sector: A Stochastic Frontier Analysis from Azerbaijan
description: Complete data, code, and reproducibility package for a study estimating a translog stochastic frontier of dairy production for 67 administrative districts of Azerbaijan (2005-2024) and linking the resulting technical efficiency scores to a yield-interpolated, IPCC Tier 1-based measure of enteric methane emission intensity. Running code/run_all.py reproduces every table and figure reported in the manuscript and its Supporting Information, with internal verification assertions checking every output against its reported value.
